messages.subject: problem with CbsModel
parts:

im processing data from cel files using two different chips
(Mapping250K_Nsp and Mapping250K_Sty). Ive followed the instructions
posted in Total Copy Number Analysis (5.0 & 6.0) using a list object
for cesNList. Everything goes well till i get to the Identification of
copy-number regions step. There what i do is:

cbs <- CbsModel(cesNList)
print(cbs)

print(ce)

Path: reports/Maribel/RBC,ACC,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-XY/Mapping250K_Nsp
+Sty/cbs
RAM: 0.00MB

process(ce, chromosomes=c(11, 14, 18), verbose=verbose)

I get the following exception:

Error en list("process(ce, chromosomes = c(11, 14, 18), verbose =
verbose)" = <environment>, :
[2008-03-31 12:16:29] Exception: Range of argument 'idx' is out of
range [1,86]: [87,87]

do u know what can be wrong?

thanks for all!!!

maria o.

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] problem with CbsModel
parts:
Hi,

please see my answers in thread 'question about an error displayed
after fit(glad)' on March 14, 2008 [ http://tinyurl.com/2z927p ].
There I also refer to online docs - please read those and make sure
you understand how aroma.affymetrix infers 'names' and 'tags' from
filenames. Then you'll understand what goes wrong and how to fix it.
If anything is unclear in those docs, please let me/us know.

Also, there is an online Vignette 'Total copy number analysis (10K,
100K, 500K)', so there is no need for you to follow the 'Total Copy
Number Analysis (5.0 & 6.0)' vignette.

Cheers

Henrik
